purpose: Define the licensed site/organization entitlement identity used to anchor AIGMos commercial rights and shared-service eligibility without becoming IdentityCore or runtime identity.

topics.name: Site License Identity
topics.purpose: Define the licensed site/organization entitlement identity used to anchor AIGMos commercial rights and shared-service eligibility without becoming IdentityCore or runtime identity.

semantics.identity_rule: Each licensed site/organization has an explicit stable license entitlement identity.
semantics.site_rule: License scope is site/organization according to the commercial contract.
semantics.iam_rule: Standard site fee may economically correspond to maintaining the licensed organization's IAM relationship/account, but IAM semantic identity remains separate.
semantics.runtime_rule: License identity does not replace AIGMos instance identity.
semantics.cert_rule: License identity/status is separate from certification identity/status.
semantics.authority_rule: Holding a license does not grant AccessCore rights inside a runtime instance.
semantics.history_rule: Renewal, expiry, upgrade and downgrade preserve entitlement history.

invariants.rule: Commercial license entitlement is explicit and separate from technical certification, semantic identity and runtime authorization.

hard_gates.condition: license id used as IdentityCore identity
runtime instance identity conflated with licensed-site identity
